Other types and coercions retain the existing native scalar path.

No new expression IR, execution provider, intermediate row representation, uncharged numeric vector, unsafe code or output borrowing. NULL slots remain initialized and output credits survive producer closure.

vortex_first_check.why_not_direct_binary_provider: Vortex ArrayBuiltins::binary preserves physical width and accepts nonfinite floating arithmetic, unlike ShardLoom promotion and strict operand/result validation. Provider integer diagnostics differ, and its input-NULL masking can suppress a nonfinite operand that ShardLoom observes before NULL propagation. A direct substitution would change semantics; the existing ShardLoom owners and checked arithmetic remain authoritative.
